extracted.name: Red Hot Applesauce Jell-O
extracted.description: Applesauce jello gets additional flavor from cinnamon candies for a sweet and delicious alternative to cranberry sauce or a light holiday dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3 ounce) package cherry-flavored gelatin (such as JELL-O®)
instruction_lines: Dissolve cinnamon candies in water in a saucepan over medium heat. Mix in gelatin and allow to dissolve; remove from heat and stir applesauce into mixture. Pour into a serving dish and refrigerate until set, about 2 hours.
